variants.headline: Government cannot pay its debts
variants.body: The government of {colony} cannot pay its debts. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: Public debt meets a payment failure
variants.body: The colony's government is unable to pay its debts. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.

variants.headline: The colony's government faces default
variants.body: Government debt in the colony cannot be paid by the administration. This gazette considers the stewardship of {target} inadequate and regards the matter as warranting critical scrutiny.
